notes.title: The price dropped to 0!
notes.notes:
Hello, from now on the game will be available for free to everyone, your chance has come, if you didn't have the game yet, now you can try to finish this game without paying anything!
[b]Good luck![/b]

notes.title: New Teleport!
notes.notes:
Now you won't have to go through the winding path of alien entrails, a portal will appear after the first kill!

notes.title: Completed, won!
notes.notes:
Post your game link here, showing that you have successfully completed the game.

The first 10 players who prove they finished the game in less than 30 minutes, will receive a key at the launch of the next game!

The player who stands out for completing in the least time, their gameplay will be highlighted and linked on the game's official page.
